person_note: The controlling narrator is Lyra, a story participant narrating in first person. Multiple Goodreads quotations expose first-person narratorial beats outside dialogue, including material associated with later parts of the novel, while the authorized Chapter 3 excerpt independently sustains the same voice and a whole-book review explicitly reports that all chapters use the main female character's first-person POV. Romantic lines addressed as 'you' are local dialogue, not second-person narration, and the few unmarked descriptions are fully compatible with Lyra's first-person narration. No credible evidence of sustained third-person or second-person sections was found. The only minor limitation is the absence of an accessible publisher statement explicitly describing the entire book's structure, but the convergent excerpt, distributed quotations, and whole-book POV description support high confidence.
